decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, 4779-EX-01, 4779-EX-02, 4779-EX-03, 4779-EX-04, 4779-EX-06, 4779-P-01, 4779-P-02, 4779-P-03, 4779-P-06, 4779-P-07, Received 27 June 2012  , therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take placed until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces and detailed drawings of the relationship between the eaves, pitched roof and flank wall of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a single storey classroom extension and modifications to existing entrance gate and wall.
